summary: The AlphaFold 3 v3.0.4 academic runtime is built with SPDX and SLSA provenance, proven by a layer walk to embed no licensed parameters and no reference-database bytes, published to the eu-north1 project registry by immutable digest, and semantically qualified on a real H100 against that exact digest.
correction_to_earlier_evidence: An earlier revision of this file claimed the H100 kubeconfig was absent and that no GPU was reachable. That was wrong. The authorized kubeconfig exists, context k8s-inference-h100 in project-e00rene/eu-north1 resolves, and the runs below were executed on it. The claim is retracted.

superseded_publications.reason: Consumed an invented reference receipt shape; never run on GPU.
PASS receipt written before upstream exited; whole-root reference mount not detected; --extra-arg could reach stage-critical flags. Never run on GPU.
Denylist for extra arguments, bypassable through Abseil --flagfile, and a handoff index carrying absolute producer paths. Passed H100 semantics but is superseded.
superseded_publications.h100_result: passed: 405 arrays on cuda:0, inference exit 0, 6 CIF files

pod_security.note: readOnlyRootFilesystem true is now proven, not just claimed.

inference_from_handoff.note: Faster than the direct run because the persistent JAX compilation cache was warm from the first inference in the same pod. This is a compiler cache, not a GPU snapshot.

h100_semantic_acceptance.cleanup: Both task-owned Jobs and both task-owned ConfigMaps were deleted. The academic claim, sibling Jobs and every other task's resources were left untouched and verified present afterwards.

node.name_withheld_reason: The compute instance name is an opaque cloud resource identifier and is withheld from the repository under the same rule as the registry account path. Its SHA-256 is recorded so an operator with cluster access can match the exact node.

layer_hygiene.method: OCI archive layer tar walk over every filesystem layer

test_evidence.note: Includes producer-generated reference receipts from the reference-data implementation now on main, the extra-argument allowlist, and the one-and-many fold-job handoff freeze.

blocked.gate: real CPU data stage against the published reference bundle
blocked.blocker: The reference-data worker has not published the AlphaFold 3 v3.0 bundle.
blocked.needed_from_operator: None. This is a handoff from the reference-data task.

blocked.blocker: Owned by the controller and adapter tasks, which consume the published contract.

readiness.reason: The runtime is semantically qualified on H100 against its exact published digest. AlphaFold 3 as a platform model is not yet servable: the reference bundle and the controller route are open.

resources_touched.cluster_mutations: two task-owned Jobs and two ConfigMaps, both deleted
resources_touched.gpu_seconds: approximately 216 across two H100 runs on one GPU
resources_touched.registry_writes: four new non-overwriting tags in fs2-models/alphafold3
